# Social Security Age

> Independent calculator of US Social Security retirement benefits for 2026, published by Radif Partners. It recomputes the primary insurance amount the way the SSA actuaries do: each year of earnings indexed to the national average wage index, the best 35 years averaged into the AIME, the bend points of the year the person turns 62, cost-of-living adjustments since then, then the reduction or delayed credits for the age benefits start. Spouse, survivor, earnings test and taxation of benefits are covered, with calculators for what comes in the same years: Medicare IRMAA surcharges, required minimum distributions, inherited IRAs, Roth conversions, HSA limits and COBRA before 65.

Every 2026 value comes from the SSA notice in the Federal Register (90 FR 49047), the SSA actuarial tables, title 20 of the Code of Federal Regulations, IRS Publication 915, CMS, the IRS life tables of 26 CFR 1.401(a)(9)-9 and the 2026 IRS revenue procedures. The engine reproduces the SSA published 2026 examples exactly. Not affiliated with the SSA; results are estimates computed in the browser.

## Pages

- [Social Security Age 2026: Publisher, Tests and Independence](https://socialsecurityage.com/en/about/): Independent publisher of Social Security Age, how it is tested and funded, why each step of the PIA is shown, and how to report a mistake on a 2026 figure.
- [AIME 2026: Average Indexed Monthly Earnings, Step by Step](https://socialsecurityage.com/en/average-indexed-monthly-earnings/): AIME in 2026: each year indexed to the wage level of the year you turned 60, capped, best 35 kept, divided by 420. SSA case A gives $5,825 and a $2,609.80 PIA.
- [Average Social Security Benefit 2026: $2,088 a Month](https://socialsecurityage.com/en/average-social-security-benefit/): Average Social Security benefit in August 2026: $2,087.52 for retired workers, $986.70 for spouses, $1,934.37 for widows and widowers. Compare your own.
- [Average Wage Index 2026: $69,846.57 for 2024, Full Table](https://socialsecurityage.com/en/average-wage-index/): National average wage index: $69,846.57 for 2024, up 4.84% on 2023. Table 1951 to 2024, indexing factors for people born in 1964, and the 2026 limits it sets.
- [COBRA Cost 2026: 102% of the Premium Until Medicare at 65](https://socialsecurityage.com/en/cobra-cost-before-medicare/): COBRA cost in 2026: up to 102% of the full plan premium, 18 to 36 months (US Labor Dept.). Compare it with a Marketplace plan before Medicare at age 65.
- [Divorced Spouse Benefits 2026: Half the Ex's PIA, Rules](https://socialsecurityage.com/en/divorced-spouse-benefits/): Divorced spouse benefits in 2026: up to 50% of the ex's PIA after a 10-year marriage, from 62, your own PIA counted first. Worked cases under 20 CFR 404.331.
- [Fewer Than 35 Years of Work: Social Security in 2026](https://socialsecurityage.com/en/fewer-than-35-years-of-work/): Fewer than 35 years of earnings in 2026: each missing year is a zero in the AIME. At $70,000 a year, 20 years give $1,812 of PIA against $2,612 for 35.
- [Full Retirement Age 2026: Table by Birth Year, to the Month](https://socialsecurityage.com/en/full-retirement-age/): Full retirement age is 67 for people born in 1960 or later, 66 and 10 months for 1959. 2026 table by birth year, the January 1 rule and the survivor table.
